|lore=Flying into an asteroid field is considered to be certain death except by Han Solo, Rycar Ryjerd and the terminally insane.
|joke=The lore jokes that only Han Solo, the smuggler [[Rycar Ryjerd]] and the "terminally insane" would fly into an asteroid field, as Han does in ''The Empire Strikes Back''. It is also a joke about plot armor: Han survives because he is the film's hero, and anyone without plot armor who tried it would be "terminally insane" in both senses, insane and terminal, dead very quickly. See [[Jokes#They'd Be Crazy To Follow Us|Jokes]].
|game_text=Use 1 Force to target a starship at an asteroid sector or a 'blown away' system. For remainder of turn, you may add 2 to destiny totals targeting the armor or maneuver of that starship.
